`template_base_image.py` now also serves the pool bake's seed of an old default-workspace-template tag (imbue-ai/mngr-internal#1143). Every tag through `minds-v0.6.2` floats `FROM python:3.12-slim-trixie`, and Docker Hub moved that tag past the `20260725T000000Z` snapshot they all pin, so a fresh build of any of them failed on apt refusing to downgrade libc6, perl-base and libsqlite3-0.

- New `PINNED_BASE_IMAGE_REF_BY_APT_SNAPSHOT_TIMESTAMP`: per apt snapshot timestamp, the digest-pinned `python:3.12-slim-trixie` whose packages that snapshot's index lists (`20260725T000000Z` -> the Debian 13.6 index `sha256:57cd7c3a…`, the same digest dwt `main` pins). A unit test pins the entry.

- New `read_template_checkout_pins` (a checkout's Dockerfile `FROM`, pinned or floating, plus its `.mngr/apt-snapshot-timestamp`) and `resolve_floating_base_image_build_context_arg`: for a floating base with a recorded pin, the BuildKit `--build-context=<name>=docker-image://<pinned ref>` flag that makes `docker build` resolve the unmodified Dockerfile's `FROM` to the pinned digest (a `--pull` still honors it); None when the Dockerfile pins its own base; an error when the base floats and its snapshot has no recorded pin or the recorded pin names another image. `parsing.py` gains `parse_image_reference` and `parse_dockerfile_from_image` (the floating-tolerant readers `parse_dockerfile_base_image` now builds on).

- Two new release tests cover every table entry: one compares the pinned image's dpkg status against its snapshot's index (amd64 and arm64, so a digest that stops being pullable is caught too), the other installs `libc6-dev perl sqlite3` from the snapshot inside it, the exact install #1138 broke.
